result.instructions: Tools for PowerHub, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders came in from Allegro yesterday and are still new?"; "How many units of the SKU 12345 do we have in each warehouse?"; "Show the tracking status of waybill 000123456789.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PowerHub data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run powerhub_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run powerhub_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run powerhub_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. powerhub_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: powerhub_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders with their status, buyer, totals and marketplace source. Filter by order date, external id, SKU, EAN, buyer e-mail or archive flag. Vendor API: GET /sm-orders/orders.

ordered_from.description: Only orders placed on or after this date-time.

ordered_to.description: Only orders placed on or before this date-time.

sku.description: Only orders that contain this SKU.

ean.description: Only orders that contain this EAN.

is_archived.description: true = archived orders only; false = active orders only.

per_page.description: Rows per page (vendor default when omitted).

tools.name: powerhub_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get one order with its receiver address, delivery method, status and remarks. Vendor API: GET /sm-orders/orders/{id}.

tools.name: powerhub_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List catalogue products with price, VAT, EAN, SKU and stock per warehouse. Filter by name, EAN, SKU, product code, manufacturer, price or quantity range. Vendor API: GET /sm-stock/products.

per_page.description: Rows per page (vendor default when omitted).

tools.name: powerhub_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one product with its base price, price lists, dimensions, weight, EAN and SKU. Vendor API: GET /sm-stock/products/{id}.

tools.name: powerhub_get_product_inventory
tools.title: Get product inventory
tools.description: Get the stock rows of one product: stock in hand, reserved, ordered and the storage place per warehouse. Vendor API: GET /sm-stock/products/{id}/inventory.

tools.name: powerhub_list_stocks
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: List the warehouses (stocks) of the account with their name and address. Vendor API: GET /sm-stock/stocks.

tools.name: powerhub_list_shipments
tools.title: List shipments
tools.description: List shipments with carrier, waybill number, receiver and status history. Filter by waybill, external id, reference, creation date or cash on delivery. Vendor API: GET /sm-shipments/shipments.

created_from.description: Created on or after this date-time.

created_to.description: Created on or before this date-time.

per_page.description: Rows per page (vendor default when omitted).

tools.name: powerhub_get_shipment
tools.title: Get shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment with its carrier, receiver, packages and status history. Vendor API: GET /sm-shipments/shipments/{id}.

tools.name: powerhub_list_carriers
tools.title: List carriers
tools.description: List the shipping carriers connected to the account. Vendor API: GET /sm-shipments/carriers.

tools.name: powerhub_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List sales documents (invoices and receipts) with buyer, amount, currency, payment type and paid amount. Vendor API: GET /sm-orders/billing/invoices.

type.description: Document type filter, as the vendor defines it.

create_from.description: Created on or after this date-time.

create_to.description: Created on or before this date-time.
